svg.text: Energy colour lanes: bolts, lobs, beams, grabs and traps
Cyan to azure, violet to magenta, molten slag and scrap, ivory and deep gold. Each kind is a core (bright centre), a main (its name colour) and an edge (the dark rim), all inside the
keyline. Flat colours only. Shapes are neutral sketches; the colours are the proposal. Red count 0 in every lane.
On the fifteen biomes at noon (ground above, rock below), beam and bolt
Whole sprite vs every biome tone at every key: default 31.4, protan 21.2, deutan 27, tritan 20.7 (need 20 / 14 / 14 / 14).
Main alone, worst: default 8.7 (ocean), protan 10.4, deutan 9.3, tritan 6.6. Red share, highest colour: linear 0.316, stored 0.326 (limit 0.8).

How to read the checks: warm hues cannot clear 20 against warm ground (desert, savanna, beach, the golden hours) with the main colour alone, and ivory cannot against snow, so every lane is
judged as a whole sprite: the bright core and the dark edge (plus the keyline) each separate from a different kind of ground. The main colour alone misses 20 on some biomes in every lane
(the numbers are above and in the doc). Flat colours only; Legal's notes (the Cyborg only throws wreckage and metal, the Empress only lines and blocks) are in the data.
Originality: cyan and violet energy are generic genre colours; the Empress's ivory-and-gold lane and the Cyborg's slag-and-scrap are our own. No franchise colour scheme is copied.
